# Hermes feature parity (generated by scripts/parity.py)

Nothing in Hermes is removed: the desktop is unmodified, and every method below is either handled or answers `not_supported_by_engine` so the UI degrades instead of breaking. Missing items are scheduled in `docs/SOVEREIGN_PLAN.md`.

**JSON-RPC methods (235):** 24 working, 9 placeholder, 202 missing. Events emitted: message.start/delta/complete, reasoning.delta, tool.start/complete, session.usage, session.title, status.update, error, gateway.ready. Server requests: approval.
